title: Metagenomics research on PAH biodegradation in the lower reaches of the Shiwuli River in Chaohu, China
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00025D, Paper
Huanling Wu, Binghua Sun, Jinhua Li
Rhodoplanes and Bradyrhizobium were abundant PAH-degrading microorganisms in the three land use types. Based on the functional annotation, it was found that the in situ microbial communities shared metabolic pathways for phenanthrene degradation.
